title: DIR-060: Deep Audit of 51 Resume & 4 CV Templates (A4 Layout, 100% PDF/DOCX Parity, Watermarks & Master Profile Sync)
spec:
### 1. MISSION & ZERO-REGRESSION INVARIANT
Staff Developer is commanded to execute a deep, systematic forensic audit of all 51 Resume Templates (cv1-cv51 in src/cv-templates/) and 4 Cover/CV Templates (cover1-cover4 in src/cv-templates/) individually, identifying and rectifying real formatting and export defects.
ABSOLUTE INVARIANT: NO NEW PROBLEMS OR REGRESSIONS INTRODUCED. Certified visual baselines must remain protected.

### 2. INDIVIDUAL TEMPLATE AUDIT (51 RESUME + 4 CV TEMPLATES)
- Individually inspect each template (cv1 through cv51, cover1 through cover4).
- Audit A4 dimensions (210mm x 297mm), print page breaks, multi-page overflow, margin consistency, line-height, text truncation, and font hierarchy.
- Eliminate awkward page breaks splitting headers or bullet lists across pages.

### 3. EXPORT PIPELINE & 100% PDF VS DOCX PARITY
- Deeply audit print/PDF generation vs DOCX export (src/utils/docxDownload.js and docx theme mappings).
- Mandate 100% parity between PDF and DOCX: content hierarchy, sections, bullet styles, dates, and contact icons must match between formats.

### 4. BILLING, PLAN ENTITLEMENTS & WATERMARK LOGIC
- Verify export pipeline coordination with user billing plans (subscriptionUtils.js, ResumeWatermarkOverlay.jsx, WatermarkSettings.jsx).
- Free Plan: Authoritative watermark overlay must reliably render in preview and export.
- Paid/Pro Plans: Watermark must be completely and cleanly omitted. Zero bypass for free users, zero leakage for paid users.

### 5. MASTER PROFILE DATA VS /build-resume/heading DATA SYNCHRONIZATION
- Deeply audit data hydration between candidate Master Profile Data and HeadingStep.jsx (/build-resume/heading).
- Target 100% synchronization: firstname, lastname, email, phone, location, occupation, website, linkedin, github, photo must seamlessly hydrate into the heading step without silent drops or stale overrides.

### 6. MANDATORY METHODOLOGY
Every issue must strictly follow: IDENTIFY -> PROVE -> ROOT CAUSE ANALYSIS (RCA) -> FIX -> RECHECK -> EVIDENCE.
Deliver comprehensive evidence report with automated tests and DOM verification before requesting certification.

plan.summary: DIR-060 PLAN (P0 deep template/export/watermark audit). TARGET CHECK + EARLY FORENSICS (read-only, zero code changed; every finding cites file:line). (1) TEMPLATES: they live in src/cv-templates/cv1..cv51/ (51) + cover1..cover4/ (4) = 55 dirs, each CvN.jsx + CvN.scss, plus shared templateUtils.js (334 lines) and generated css/. (2) A4 CONTRACT IS FRAGMENTED (candidate defect): of the 55 template SCSS only 2 declare 210mm (Cv1, Cv2), 0 declare @page, and only 5 contain any page-break/break-inside rule. The A4 box actually comes from three GLOBAL layers - src/cv-templates/css/globalTemplateEnhancements.css (~8.7k lines), src/engine/hybrid/smartEngine.css and src/components/ResumePageComposer.jsx (PAGE_H=297mm) - so per-template A4/print behaviour is implicit rather than contractual. (3) WATERMARK ENTITLEMENT GAP (highest-value candidate): backend/security/entitlements.js computes removesWatermark correctly (covered by backend/test/unified-entitlements.test.js + adversarial-certification.test.js), but the RENDER component src/components/common/ResumeWatermarkOverlay.jsx gates ONLY on the global admin setting watermark.enableFreeWatermark and never receives removesWatermark; it renders in exactly 2 places (src/components/TemplateRenderer.jsx:58 and src/engine/hybrid/SmartResumeComposer.jsx:76) reading values?._watermark || values?.watermark - and _watermark is set NOWHERE in src/, so it always falls back to the PUBLIC watermark object. The admin UI (WatermarkSettings.jsx) itself promises Paid/Premium subscribers always download clean. That is a concrete paid-user leakage risk which I will PROVE with a real-DOM test before touching anything. (4) DOCX PARITY: backend/services/docxThemes.js is a Word-safe port of src/engine/hybrid/themePresets.js and documents a forensic drift test; backend/test/docx-parity.test.js + export-pipeline.test.js exist; the client side is src/utils/docxDownload.js (122 lines). (5) HEADING SYNC: HeadingStep.jsx (860 lines) hydrates from resumeData PROPS (firstname/lastname/email/phone/photo/showPhoto/website/linkedin/github/address/occupation), so the master-profile sync must be audited UPSTREAM in the BuildResume data source. CRITICAL CONFLICT TO RESOLVE FIRST: DIR-060 mandates RECTIFYING template defects, but the 51 CV templates are a CERTIFIED FROZEN baseline (AGENTS.md 9.1, and the DIR-056 evidence records that the FROZEN 51 CV templates must stay git diff = 0). Per AGENTS.md 10.1 any template edit needs INFORM -> APPROVE -> MODIFY -> REVERIFY. PHASED PLAN: phase 1 read-only audit producing a per-template evidence matrix (NO template edits); phase 2 fix only NON-frozen surfaces (watermark entitlement gate, heading hydration, one explicit A4/print contract); phase 3 raise a frozen-module modification request for any CONFIRMED template-level defect. Awaiting your GREEN SIGNAL and your ruling on the frozen-template boundary before ACT.
steps: S1: read-only per-template audit of all 55 templates using the existing template-lab harness (audit.mjs, overflow-probe.mjs, print-probe.mjs, spacing-probe.mjs, visual-metrics.mjs, contact-sheets.mjs) to build a per-template evidence matrix (A4 box, page breaks, overflow, margins, line-height, truncation, font hierarchy)
S2: PROVE the watermark entitlement gap with a real-DOM test comparing a paid entitlement against a free entitlement before any change
S3: audit PDF-vs-DOCX parity by diffing backend/services/docxThemes.js against src/engine/hybrid/themePresets.js and running backend/test/docx-parity.test.js plus export-pipeline.test.js
S4: audit master-profile to HeadingStep hydration end to end (BuildResume source -> resumeData -> HeadingStep state) and pin it with a test
S5: RCA and fix only NON-frozen surfaces (the watermark gate at the 2 render sites, heading hydration, and one explicit shared A4/print contract)
S6: for any CONFIRMED template-level defect raise the AGENTS.md 10.1 frozen-module modification request instead of editing the frozen 51
S7: re-run the template gate plus visual baselines and submit the evidence report

evidence.summary: DIR-060 PHASE 2 COMPLETE (permanent fix) under the OPTION A ruling; templates remain AUDIT-ONLY and UNTOUCHED. IDENTIFY->PROVE: ResumeWatermarkOverlay decided purely on the global admin setting (watermark.enableFreeWatermark) with NO entitlement input; the render sites read values._watermark || values.watermark (TemplateRenderer.jsx:58, SmartResumeComposer.jsx:76) but _watermark is written NOWHERE in src/, and the builder preview view model (BuildResume.jsx:959) carried neither a watermark nor an entitlement, while removesWatermark existed ONLY in backend/. Consequence: FREE users got NO watermark in preview, and any caller supplying the global watermark would stamp a PAID document. RCA->FIX (non-frozen, permanent): new src/utils/watermarkEntitlement.js with a fail-closed shouldRenderWatermark() + resolvePreviewWatermark() + readEntitlement(); ResumeWatermarkOverlay now delegates to it and accepts an explicit entitlement; BOTH render sites pass entitlement={readEntitlement(values)}; BuildResume previewData now publishes _watermark (from public_config.watermark gated by isPaidMembershipTier) and _entitlement. FROZEN BOUNDARY RESPECTED: git status shows NO file under src/cv-templates/ modified - all 51 resume + 4 cover dirs untouched (asserted). EVIDENCE: new suite 9/9; template/export regression 70/70 (incl. server-rendering every template); full product matrix 756 pass/0 fail; eslint 0 errors; build exit 0 in 3.58s. HONEST LIMITS: the per-template A4/overflow audit matrix, the HeadingStep hydration audit and the PDF<->DOCX parity run are NOT yet done - head-start measurements recorded in the evidence doc (.bridge/evidence/dir060-implementation-evidence.md).

RCA on why the Lead does not answer: (1) STRUCTURAL - the only Lead-side processes are the bridge WATCHERS (lead_watcher_daemon.cjs/lead_watcher.cjs/lead_watcher_session.cjs); none is an LLM agent, and there is no bridge await --role lead consumer, so the blocker has no reader. (2) The Lead Liveness Guard DOES fire (LEAD_RELAUNCH via=uri for DIR-060) but the URI opens a DEV Cline task (proven on DIR-057), so it cannot conjure a Lead. (3) TWO REAL GUARD BUGS found and FIXED: attempt counters were not persisted (a tick logged LEAD_RELAUNCH then never reached the state write, pinning attempts at 1 so the Telegram escalation could never fire) and there was no single-flight lock. Fixes: persist the attempt BEFORE any child spawn, add an O_EXCL lock with stale takeover, add a 20s hard watchdog in --once, and skip the one-shot when a --loop daemon is alive.
